title: What a stop loss actually saves you
note: Educational reel. The hard-stop rule is the payoff. No performance claim — explains what a stop loss does and why Lumin sets one on every position automatically. Claims sourced from app onboarding and 360-v2 hard limits (B7: each evaluator owns its SL/TP geometry, naked-position invariant enforced).
voice: Most people learn what a stop loss is the hard way. Here is the short version. A stop loss is the price where your trade closes automatically, so a bad position does not turn into a disaster. The size of the loss is decided before the trade opens. Not after. Lumin sets a stop on every position before it touches the market. You cannot open a trade without one. That one rule is what keeps a losing trade from becoming the trade that wipes your account.
